To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the machine learning approach of learning to rank (LTR) can be applied to data flow analysis, and (2) the resulting LTR-based data flow analysis can be used to make better optimization decisions than state-of-the-art compiler optimizations.
• We can train machine learning models to perform data flow analysis on programs.

(1) deep learning is capable of replicating a wide class of data flow analyses; (2) deep learning can replicate data flow analysis in an end-to-end manner, including the analysis, optimization, and verification steps; and (3) the deep learning models are capable of learning to replicate the analysis in a manner similar to the way a human would, by using the analysis of a related program to infer the analysis of the target program.

building machine learning methods that are as good as the best of the existing compiler technology.
the development of deep learning methods that can replicate the abstract interpretations of traditional data flow analysis.
the design of a new class of machine learning algorithms that are capable of replicating the abstract interpretations of classic data flow analysis algorithms.
